evidenceLimit: Current first-party metrics do not contain note PV, likes, follows, paid-outbound clicks, related-paid purchases or revenue by theme. No note, BOOTH, Microsoft Store or GitHub Pages theme is yet a proven revenue winner from the available metrics.

hardFloorSnapshot.rule: Free note output never substitutes for paid publication floors.

note.publishedFreeEvidence: The initial free cohort is reader-visible, but the available metrics file has no 24h/72h/7d funnel outcomes yet.
decisionRules: Strong free engagement alone is a demand signal, not proof of a revenue winner.
Observed paid purchase makes the theme a strong winner candidate and justifies adjacent free search-intent satellites plus BOOTH/Store expansion evaluation.
Strong free signal with weak paid conversion triggers CTA, value-gap, price and theme-match optimization before derivative production.
Weak free and weak paid evidence means do not amplify.
Compare equal post-publication windows only; missing values remain unknown.
note.amplificationHold: Do not mass-produce derivatives from these pairs until comparable first-party evidence is recorded.

MicrosoftStore.derivativePolicy: Do not create cosmetic CSV variants before the live listing has acquisition/usage evidence. Meaningful format/use-case derivatives may be evaluated only after evidence or independently strong market evidence.

BOOTH.derivativePolicy: Do not infer winners from publication count. Prefer bundles/templates only after sales or cross-channel demand evidence appears.

GitHubPages.derivativePolicy: Use measured PV/outbound conversion when available; do not create name-only SEO variants.

executionBacklog.nextAction: Capture 24h outcomes for each reader-visible free/paid pair as they mature. If free signal is strong but paid movement is weak, optimize CTA/value difference/price/theme match before adding derivatives.
Maintain high-quality paid inventory for the next floor without claiming any item is a winner before observed sales/conversion evidence.
Complete every non-human submission prerequisite and obtain a live Store listing before derivative-app amplification.

When a paid purchase or strong comparable conversion signal is recorded, create an evidence-backed expansion card containing source winner, evidence, derivative concept, incremental expected profit, cannibalization risk, production cost and priority; then evaluate adjacent free search intent, BOOTH kit/bundle and a genuinely distinct Store tool.
Improve instrumentation and verified context-matched outbound links on existing surfaces so future winner decisions can use measured PV/CVR rather than publication count.

rules: Previous-day paid debt outranks discretionary amplification when debt exists.
Free note publications never replace paid debt/floor.
Do not invent PV, likes, follows, clicks, purchases, revenue, acquisitions, retention or CVR.
Do not call a theme a winner from publication count or a free reaction alone.
Do not clone low-signal themes or cosmetic Store variants.
Missing platform-native metrics stay unknown, not zero.
Amplification requires meaningful user-value differentiation and evidence sufficient for the channel.
